placement_period_monitoring.note: Opened by the ticket 6 fold of input pack items 2 and 8. The action now runs 30 months, WP5 ends at M30, and the five draft milestones all fall at or before M23. That leaves the M23-M30 placement period with no milestone and the M6/M12/M16/M20 decision points with a ten-month unmonitored tail. Input pack item 8 raises two candidates — moving or companioning MS5 with a placement-completion milestone, and adding a fifth steering point at M27 — and the operator decided neither. Neither is invented here (§13.3): a milestone with a fabricated month and criterion would be exactly the kind of project fact the seed rule forbids. Phase 4 owns milestone definition and can resolve this from the extended WP5 range; ticket 7 should surface it, because it is visible to an evaluator reading the Gantt.
candidates_raised_not_decided: A placement-completion milestone at the end of the M25-M30 window
A fifth Steering Group decision point at M27
placement_period_monitoring.gate_impact: phase_04_gate requires every milestone to carry a verifiable criterion and the timeline to fit the duration. Five milestones inside a 30-month timeline satisfy both. The gap is a quality matter, not a gate failure.
